photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 17:24:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 2468 s; on-screen clock 04/30/13 17:24:50, wanted 17:24:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT 13-119  17:24-17:31' on 2013-04-29 (`as run matrix!B112`), read as 2013-04-29 17:24. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-29 plus one day, 17:24: it was found 2418 s into this video, and in no other video.
